I have enough understanding of both the current script and how `npx skills` actually works. Here's what I've confirmed:

- `npx skills` canonical layout: copies the skill into `.agents/skills/<name>/` (project = `<cwd>/.agents/skills`, global = `~/.agents/skills`), then creates **relative symlinks** from each non-universal agent dir (e.g. `.claude/skills/<name> -> ../../.agents/skills/<name>`). "Universal" agents (cursor, codex, opencode, gemini, copilot, warp, zed…) read `.agents/skills` directly, so they need no symlink.
- Your machine matches this exactly: `~/.claude/skills/* -> ../../.agents/skills/*`, and `dongwu-tick-cli` exists only in `~/.agents/skills/` with no `~/.claude` symlink (so it was placed without the fan-out).
- This repo is a special "publishing repo": canonical content lives in `skills/local/<name>`, and `.agents/skills/` + `.claude/skills/` are symlink farms pointing back to `skills/local`. The current `new-skill.sh` writes to `skills/local/<name>` but does **not** create those discovery symlinks, and it hard-errors when run outside a repo that has a `skills/` dir.
- `npx skills add` accepts a local path and has `-g/--global` + `--copy`; its scope auto-detect rule is "project if in a project, else global".

Two design forks will significantly change the implementation, so I want your call before writing the plan.

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7)**_

所有 todo 完成。以下是这次修改的总结：

## 实施摘要

### 核心改动

[`skills/local/skill-author/scripts/new-skill.sh`](skills/local/skill-author/scripts/new-skill.sh) 完整重写为三种 **placement scope**，全部保持 bash 3.2 离线（无新增依赖），并和 `npx skills add` 的 placement contract 完全一致：

| Scope | 触发条件 | Canonical dir | 自动建立的 Symlinks |
|---|---|---|---|
| **LOCAL** | 往上找到 `vendor.yaml` / `skills/local/` / `skills/.claude-plugin/` | `<repo>/skills/local/<name>/` (或 `skills/vendor/` 配 `--vendor`) | `.agents/skills/<name>` + `.claude/skills/<name>` → `../../skills/{local,vendor}/<name>` |
| **PROJECT** | 找到 `.git` | `<repo>/.agents/skills/<name>/` (Cursor/Codex/OpenCode/Warp 直接读取) | `.claude/skills/<name>` → `../../.agents/skills/<name>` (+ repo root 已存在的其他非通用 agent dir) |
| **GLOBAL** | 都没找到或 `--global` | `~/.agents/skills/<name>/` | `~/.claude/skills/<name>` → `../../.agents/skills/<name>` (+ `$HOME` 下已存在的其他非通用 agent dir) |

新增 flags：`--local` / `--project` / `--global`（互斥），`--no-symlinks`；保留 `--vendor` / `--root` / `--dry-run` / `--force` / `--help`。Output 改为结构化 JSON：`{skill, mode, canonical, symlinks[], next_steps[]}`，exit code 增加 `4`（symlink 验证失败）。

### 关键设计

- **Symlink relativity** 严格遵循 [`pitfalls/symlink-target-relative-to-symlink-not-cwd.md`](pitfalls/symlink-target-relative-to-symlink-not-cwd.md)：全部用固定 `../../` 前缀（canonical 和 link parent 在每种 scope 下都正好在 base dir 下两层），每个 `ln -s` 后立刻 `test -e <link>/SKILL.md` 验证，dangling 直接 exit 4。
- **Fan-out 纪律** 复刻上游 `npx skills add`：claude-code 永远建；其他非通用 agent 只在它的 config root 已存在于 base dir 时才建。从不为用户其实没用的 agent 凭空创建 `.windsurf/` 之类。
- **Bash 3.2 安全**：用 heredoc (`<<EOF`) 而非 pipe 喂 `while read`，确保 `link_into` 的 `SYMLINKS_CREATED` 修改和 `die` 的 `exit` 在 parent shell 生效。

### 文档更新

- [`skills/local/skill-author/SKILL.md`](skills/local/skill-author/SKILL.md) — 改写第 2 步 Scaffold（含三 scope 表格）、Available scripts、Gotchas（含「intent 不明时先问 user system-wide vs project-wide」的指引）。
- [`skills/local/skill-author/references/this-repo-conventions.md`](skills/local/skill-author/references/this-repo-conventions.md) — 修掉「legacy `.agents/skills/`」的过时说法，新增完整三 scope 章节。
- [`docs/workflows/creating-local-skills.md`](docs/workflows/creating-local-skills.md) + [`.zh-TW.md`](docs/workflows/creating-local-skills.zh-TW.md) — `new-skill.sh` 作为主推荐路径，`npx skills init` 降为「仅 skeleton」备选。
- [`docs/reference/scripts.md`](docs/reference/scripts.md) + [`.zh-TW.md`](docs/reference/scripts.zh-TW.md) — 新增「Skill authoring」章节，详列 `new-skill.sh` + `lint-skill.sh`。
- [`README.md`](README.md) — 更新「Adding a new local skill」snippet，强调 scope 自动检测。
- [`pitfalls/symlink-target-relative-to-symlink-not-cwd.md`](pitfalls/symlink-target-relative-to-symlink-not-cwd.md) — 追加「Now enforced by new-skill.sh」段落。

### 验证通过

- `bash -n` 语法 OK；bash 3.2 forbidden-idiom 扫描乾净。
- `lint-skill.sh skills/local/skill-author` → 0 errors / 0 warnings。
- `make marketplace` + `make kanban` 都仍通过。
- LOCAL / PROJECT / GLOBAL 三种 scope 在 `--dry-run` 下产生的路径都正确。
- 在 `/tmp/<scratch>/proj`（`git init` 过）跑真实 `--project`：canonical 写入 `.agents/skills/e2e-skill/SKILL.md`，`.claude/skills/e2e-skill -> ../../.agents/skills/e2e-skill` 用 `test -e .../SKILL.md` 解析成功。
- JSON 输出可解析，5 个 key (`canonical / mode / next_steps / skill / symlinks`) 齐全。
- 嵌套子目录 (`skills/local/skill-author/scripts/`) 跑 script，walk-up 正确找到 publishing-repo anchor 并 auto-detect 为 LOCAL。
- Arg validation 都拒绝得对：冲突 scope flag → exit 1，`--vendor --project` → exit 1，invalid name → exit 1，`--local` 在非 publishing dir → exit 3。
